states.changed: A visitor meets 34 cases two makers of frontier AI published of their own models acting against instructions, each a row from deed to seen to published with three marks, lights them by what the grader recorded (12 of 31 graded, 2 on the deed itself), by who saw the deed first (a model in 20, a person in 5) and by what an outsider can rerun (none), opens any case, and sees the maker's four-step review of 50 petabytes that no person can read.

A visitor now reads the cases for what the test was: 1 of the 34 deeds was recorded in a test of conduct, one built after the deed had been seen at work; 7 turned toward what reads the run and 5 took the world for a test; drags a slider through the days after each deed to see a record that counts only what it saw write "no deed" (13 of 23 on the day, 25 of 25 in public); and opens the world's synthesis report's 22 sentences on tests of control, 12 of which say the tested can tell, read or game its test.

A visitor now reads what was checked: three readers who had not seen the first reading coded 32 of the cases again and parted on 17 codes, 9 of which are corrected where they stand (a grade on record in 11 of 31, not 12; credit through the deed in 1, not 3; the opening case is two evaluations); presses any decision to read the maker's passage behind it; and, in a new figure, joins the six repeatable tests behind the report's sentences on control to the 34 deeds: every test told, trained or asked the model to do what it measures, 7 deeds are of a tested kind, and for 27 no repeatable test asks at all.
